question: Under which scheme will 500 new 'waste to wealth' plants be established, as per the 2023-24 Union Budget of the Government of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**GOBARdhan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **GOBARdhan (Galvanizing Organic Bio-Agro Resources Dhan) scheme** was introduced as part of the **2018-19 Union Budget** by the Government of India.
 
• It aims to support the establishment of **biogas plants** and promote organic waste management by converting waste into valuable resources such as **bioenergy and organic fertilizers**.
 
• As per the **2023-24 Union Budget**, the government has announced the establishment of **500 new 'waste-to-wealth' plants** under this scheme to address agricultural and organic waste effectively.
 
• These plants include **200 compressed biogas (CBG) plants**, including **75 plants** in urban areas.
 
• The scheme aligns with the goals of **Sustainable Development** by reducing waste, promoting renewable energy, and generating employment opportunities in rural areas.
 
• The GOBARdhan scheme is implemented under the **Swachh Bharat Mission (Gramin)** to promote cleanliness,
